name: Messaging
description: Send multimedia messages to the user: images, audio, video, documents, HTML widgets, notification emails via Resend, and public share links for workspace files

changelog.notes: Public share links: share-file / unshare-file / get-share over the backend share.* WS domain (same actions the FileViewer UI uses). The generated URL is public — anyone with it can view the file until revoked.
Initial release — send images, audio, video, and documents to the chat, plus live HTML previews
